name: taleforge
label: Taleforge
tagline: Text adventures with real rules, romance and Jan as narrator

help.about: Text adventures with real rules: dice, a character sheet, a party and quests. A local Jan model narrates each turn.

manifest.summary: A data-driven text RPG engine: d20 rules, character creation, skill checks shown as rolls, turn-based combat, levels, quests, shops, companions with affection meters and branching romance arcs, and saved games. Every rule set and world is JSON (rulesets/, campaigns/), so a new genre or campaign is new files only. The engine owns every number; Jan only retells what happened (narration and dialogue are separate per-app model settings, loaded on demand; a missing model file falls back to an installed one). Ships with The Hollow Crown (fantasy romance) and Neon Debt (cyberpunk). Free-text input plus buttons; works with Jan off.
